qualityGate.reason: The Playwright artifact compiles and uses correct Playwright APIs, including awaiting asynchronous assertions. However, the selector appears to be a data-test attribute which is good, but the test lacks strong assertion coverage on page content beyond URL verification, reducing assertion strength and maintainability. The test case ID is not preserved in the test title. The code is simple and maintainable but could improve reusability by parameterizing baseURL and adding more assertions to confirm the category page content.
